headline: TS Lombard Warns AI Investment Boom Resembles a Bubble
summary: Research firm TS Lombard stated that the AI investment theme constitutes a bubble that is destined to pop, advising investors against trying to time the peak.
why: High valuations in artificial intelligence-related equities have raised systemic concerns among macroeconomic forecasters and institutional asset managers.

impacts.name: Artificial Intelligence
impacts.why: Macroeconomic warnings about valuation bubbles can trigger sentiment-driven volatility in high-multiple tech stocks.
